invariants: asset, persisted detail, history and PostgreSQL topology are read under one tenant-scoped repeatable-read snapshot
the authenticated tenant is the only tenant authority and an asset from another tenant is indistinguishable from an absent asset

ClickHouse observations and alert context resolve the current PostgreSQL-owned IP identity for the stable asset ID, bind tenant plus bounded lookback plus PostgreSQL as_of, and never use a UI-provided identity
latest alert state uses deterministic argMax(state_version, updated_at, event_id) over the bounded raw alert stream and does not require a broad FINAL scan
NebulaGraph detail reads bind tenant_id plus stable asset_id and a hard relation limit; they never call the whole-tenant workbench loader
a NebulaGraph revision mismatch, future watermark or relation truncation remains partial until reconciled with the PostgreSQL asset revision
object evidence starts from bounded alert evidence IDs, resolves tenant-scoped ClickHouse evidence records and verifies MinIO Stat metadata; missing objects or SHA256 remain partial

unavailable ClickHouse observations, alert context, evidence objects and Nebula projection are listed in missing_sections and never synthesized from UI arrays, metadata arrays or hard-coded IP addresses
every returned section names an authoritative source watermark and topology edges preserve server-provided identity and direction
domain.compensation: disable the additive snapshot endpoint and retain the four existing read endpoints; no business state is mutated

data.migration: read-only additive contract; no schema migration required for the PostgreSQL subset

negative_tests: an unauthenticated or asset-read-denied identity cannot read any snapshot section
a cross-tenant asset ID returns no asset, details, history, topology, observation, alert or evidence fact

stop_conditions: history or topology exceeds the hard limit, repeatable-read transaction exceeds the approved budget, missing sections are rendered as zero-valued success, or tenant filtering is absent

tests: G0 OpenAPI, feature contract and Go regression
G1 snapshot identity, explicit partial, bounds, scope and cross-tenant tests
G2 real PostgreSQL repeatable-read snapshot plus approved CH, alert, MinIO and Nebula readers
G3 sampled asset reconciliation across PG, CH, alerts, evidence manifest and graph projection
G4 fixed-scale detail and topology P50/P95/P99 resource budget
G5 Windows Chrome detail tabs, partial labels, graph and evidence deep links
evidence: one trace_id and snapshot_id bind the browser response, source watermarks, authoritative rows and projection reconciliation
